terms.gloss: a forget-me-not: the botanists’ name for the kind
evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Myosotis arvensis (L.) Hill, Field Forget-me-not
terms.comment: In Pliny (NH 27.105) myosōta or myosōtis is a plant called mouse-ear (Lewis & Short); the botanists gave the name to the forget-me-nots.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
